reason: Neither component window shows a credible emission feature: around 8330 Å the flux is a flat continuum with no peak at the predicted center, and around 8375 Å likewise no distinct line is visible (the claimed 8430 Å center is far from prediction and shows only a low-ivar dip). The measured separation (~126 Å) is grossly inconsistent with the expected ~45 Å, and both single-feature states are signal_absent, so the two-component interpretation is not corroborated.
